# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability, exposed credential, unsafe hook, or supply-chain concern.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Include the affected primitive or plugin, reproduction steps, impact, and any safe remediation guidance.

## Scope

Security reports may cover repository scripts, executable hooks, generated plugin packages, MCP configurations, client extensions, or instructions that could cause unsafe actions.

Public support questions and non-sensitive defects belong in GitHub Issues.
